title: Fix routes: limit session/passwords routes to only defined actions
description: config/routes.rb:3 uses resource :session which generates show/edit/update — only new/create/destroy exist in SessionsController. Hitting GET /session raises AbstractController::ActionNotFound. Same for resources :passwords (generates index/show/destroy) — only new/create/edit/update exist. Fix: use 'only: [:new, :create, :destroy]' on session and 'only: [:new, :create, :edit, :update]' on passwords.

title: Add Pundit policy tests for all 9 policies
description: Zero Pundit policies have tests. app/policies/ directory has no corresponding test/policies/ directory. Add tests for: ApplicationPolicy, PostPolicy, SubjectPolicy (complex Scope logic), MessagePolicy (5-min destroy window, role branching), ChatRoomPolicy (private/public branching), UserPolicy, DepartmentPolicy, CollegePolicy, AuditLogPolicy. Test authorization rules for each user role (student, teacher, admin, unenrolled).

title: Fix critical data loss: Post discard hard-deletes all comments
description: Post has_many :comments, dependent: :destroy. When a post is soft-deleted via Discard::Model, the discard triggers dependent: :destroy which permanently hard-deletes every comment. Comments have no discarded_at column — they are unrecoverable. Fix: change dependent to :nullify, or skip dependent callbacks on discard, or add discard to Comment model.

title: Fix messages.content NOT NULL blocking attachment-only sends (500 error)
description: db/schema.rb defines messages.content as t.text null: false, but app/models/message.rb validates content presence only unless attachments exist. Sending a message with only attachments (no text) passes model validation but crashes at DB with SQLite3::ConstraintException. Fix: make content nullable via migration, or set default empty string.

title: Fix Host Header regex anchoring
description: config/environments/production.rb config.hosts regex /.*\.morafeq\.hazembook\.com/ matches as substring anywhere in the Host header. Anchor with \A and \z to prevent host header injection.
acceptance_criteria: Regex anchored with \A/\z; test with Host: evil.morafeq.hazembook.com.attacker.com returns 403; legitimate hosts still pass
close_reason: Anchored config.hosts regex with \A and \z to prevent host header injection via substring matching. Previously /.*\.morafeq\.hazembook\.com/ matched anywhere in the Host header — now it must match the entire value.

title: Remove data-turbo-frame='_top' from mark-as-read button

But the server responds with just the <turbo-frame id='read_status_post_X'> fragment. Remove _top so the form submits within the containing Turbo Frame and the response updates only that frame.

close_reason: Added before_validation :set_content_default callback that sets content to empty string when attachments present and content blank, preventing NOT NULL constraint violation on attachment-only messages.

title: Add solid_cache.connects_to for multi-db
description: SolidCache was configured as the cache store but never had connects_to set, so it defaulted to the primary database instead of the cache database. When rate limiting (SessionsController#create) wrote to Rails.cache, SolidCache tried to write solid_cache_entries to the primary DB where the table doesn't exist, causing a 500 on POST /session. Fix: add config.solid_cache.connects_to = { database: { writing: :cache } } in production.rb, following SolidQueue's existing pattern.
close_reason: Added config.solid_cache.connects_to = { database: { writing: :cache } } in production.rb. Verified against SolidCache README and Rails Caching Guide — both accept connects_to approach. Demo deployed and POST /session returns 302 instead of 500.

title: Add content-type spoofing protection via binary magic bytes
description: All 6 models with Active Storage attachments (Material, Assignment, AssignmentSubmission, Post, Message, User/avatar) validate content_type from client-supplied metadata. A user can upload an executable with content_type: 'image/png' and bypass validation. Fix: validate actual file magic bytes using a gem like marcel/mimemagic or a custom validator, or at minimum enforce that the blob's content_type matches the detected type via ActiveStorage::Blob.analyze.

title: Fix race condition creating duplicate private chat rooms
description: ChatRoom.find_or_create_private does find-then-create without a transaction/lock. Two concurrent requests between the same user pair can create duplicate private rooms. Fix: wrap in a transaction with database-level unique constraint, or use find_or_create_by! on a sorted pair hash.

title: Attendance create action silently crashes on bad input
description:
AttendancesController#create rescues only ActiveRecord::RecordInvalid but the action can fail with:
- ArgumentError from Date.parse(params[:date]) on invalid date strings
- ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound from @subject.students.find(user_id) on tampered/out-of-range student IDs

Both result in a 500 error instead of a user-friendly redirect. Fix: widen rescue to catch StandardError (or add specific rescues for ArgumentError and ActiveRecord::RecordNotFound), or validate inputs before processing.

On mobile screens, the 4-column teacher index table and the radio button columns in the record form get clipped — teachers cannot see or interact with rightmost elements. Fix: replace overflow-hidden with overflow-x-auto on both tables. Also consider making the teacher index table responsive (e.g., stacking on very small screens or using a card layout for each student).
close_reason: Replaced overflow-hidden with overflow-x-auto on attendance table containers in index (teacher view) and record form, fixing clipped columns on mobile.

title: CSP controller blocks unauthenticated violation reports
description: CspController inherits before_action :require_authentication from ApplicationController without skipping it. CSP violation reports from unauthenticated browsers (which is the normal case — CSP reports come from user browsers, not authenticated sessions) get redirected to the login page instead of being logged. acceptance_criteria: POST to unknown room returns 404; POST to room without membership returns 403; room participant can still post; integration test covers all three cases
close_reason: Added authorize @room, :show? to MessagesController#create. Previously any authenticated user could POST messages to any chat_room_id, including private rooms they don't belong to. Now Pundit enforces room visibility before message creation.

title: Session hardening — UUID tokens, expiry, rotation
description: Session IDs are integer primary keys stored in a signed permanent cookie (20yr expiry). No expiry on Session records. No rotation on escalation/logout. Replace with UUID tokens, set short-lived server-side expiry, rotate on role escalation and logout.
acceptance_criteria: Session cookie stores UUID token, not integer PK; session records have expires_at; expired sessions rejected; session rotated on logout and role change; existing sessions migrated or gracefully invalidated
close_reason: Replaced integer PK session cookies with SecureRandom tokens (32-byte hex). Added expires_at (30 day absolute expiry) and last_used_at columns. Expired sessions destroyed on access. Cookie expiry matches session expiry instead of permanent. last_used_at refreshed every 5 minutes. All existing sessions backfilled with new tokens and expiry. Tests pass, quality gates clean.

title: Validate uploaded file content types

acceptance_criteria: Reject uploads with text/html, application/xhtml, text/javascript; inline view forces safe Content-Type (application/octet-stream or matched to allowlist); existing materials unaffected
close_reason: Added content-type and size validation to Post attachment, Message attachment, and User avatar uploads. MaterialsController#show now forces safe Content-Type or forces download. Shared file type constants extracted. Inlined content_types_allowed_inline in production.rb (no constant reference at precompile time). Tests pass, deployed to staging.

close_reason: Refactored all inline JavaScript into Stimulus controllers (lightbox gallery, file labels, auto-submit) and enabled Content Security Policy in report-only mode. title: Fix Turbo cache re-fetch on lazy read_status/post_actions frames
description:
Lazy Turbo frames (read_status, post_actions) re-fetch on back/forward navigation because Turbo restores cached pages and re-executes the src attribute. This causes the mark-as-read button to flash/re-appear after clicking it and navigating away/back.

Fix options:
1. Add Cache-Control: no-cache headers to FeedController#read_status and #post_actions actions
2. Use data-turbo-cache="false" on the feed layout (nuclear option)
3. Switch to user-specific Turbo Stream broadcasts instead of lazy frames

Recommended: Option 1 (Cache-Control headers) — least invasive, most targeted.

See app/controllers/feed_controller.rb (read_status, post_actions actions) and app/views/feed/_read_status.html.erb, app/views/feed/_post_actions.html.erb.
close_reason: Combined fix in commit b2fe212 (Refs: morafeq-9ff): the original flicker fix plus the follow-up that guards src-stripping on actually-loaded frames.

title: Mark as Read button doesn't update until page refresh
description:
Clicking "Mark as Read" on feed index page creates PostView (verified: persists after refresh) but the button doesn't swap to "✓ Read" badge until manual page reload.

Root cause: the form generated by button_to is inside turbo-frame page_1. Despite form having data-turbo-frame="_top", Turbo's handling of the form submission within a nested frame context prevents the Turbo Stream response from being processed correctly.

Attempted fixes:
- Changed to link_to with data-turbo-method + redirect
- Changed to link_to without turbo_frame + Turbo Stream response
- Changed to button_to with form: { data: { turbo_frame: "_top" } } + Turbo Stream

Next approach: use a dedicated Stimulus controller that sends fetch() + Turbo.renderStreamMessage() directly, bypassing frame-based form submission.
close_reason: Fixed: replaced Stimulus+JSON+outerHTML with simple button_to + data-turbo-frame=_top + redirect. 153 tests, 0 offenses.
